ingredients.notes: All ingredients use edible gram weights. Allergen disclosures and the new illustration were checked against the ingredient list.

method.notes: Plant-based adaptation with pressed long-grain rice, firm tofu and coconut vegetables. The compressed rice reference uses two cups water per cup rice by volume; 250 g per 100 g dry rice is a compatible weight ratio. Cook until absorbed and soft, press in a 2 cm layer, chill rapidly, then reheat once until steaming throughout. Dry rice, edible trimmed produce and drained tofu are weighed. Full cooking-oil retention. No physical trial.

food_safety.notes: Cool pressed rice immediately in a shallow layer within one hour, refrigerate at most 24 hours and reheat only once until steaming throughout. Disclose soy and check broth allergens.

servings_and_time.notes: 2 portions with 85 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
